entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]You received [VAR 0x0204(0001,002C)] BP from the guidance\ncounselor!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_system_01

entries.text: Hey there, exchange student! Your friendly\nneighborhood guidance counselor here!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_01

entries.text: Hope it doesn’t feel too invasive for me to ask...\nAre you keeping up with your Pokémon battles?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_02

entries.text:
Here at Blueberry Academy, we try to get the
students excited to battle each other.\c
Which means I’ll give you BP for battling the
students here—the more battles, the more BP!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_03

entries.text: So, why don’t you try to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] student[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s here\nin the Savanna Biome?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_04a

entries.text: So, why don’t you try to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] student[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s here\nin the Canyon Biome?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_04b

entries.text: So, why don’t you try to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] student[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s here\nin the Coastal Biome?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_04c

entries.text: So, why don’t you try to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] student[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s here\nin the Polar Biome?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_04d

entries.text: So far, you’ve defeated [VAR 0x0201(0003)] student[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s here in the\nSavanna Biome!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_05a

entries.text: So far, you’ve defeated [VAR 0x0201(0003)] student[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s here in the\nCanyon Biome!

entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_05c

entries.text: So far, you’ve defeated [VAR 0x0201(0003)] student[VAR 0x1101(0003,0100)]s here in the\nPolar Biome!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_05d

entries.text: Come see me again once you’ve defeated\n[VAR 0x0201(0002)] students, OK?
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_06

entries.text: Wow, great job! Look at you, being all proactive\nabout finding other students to battle!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_07

entries.text: Here’s some BP for you—a reward for all that\nhard work!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_08

entries.text: And here’s a little bonus from me!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_09

entries.text: Your next goal is to defeat [VAR 0x0201(0002)] student[VAR 0x1101(0002,0100)]s...\nWait a second—are you already done?!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_10

entries.text: If you go and get yourself even more wins, I’ll\nhave another reward waiting here for you!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_11

entries.text: Wait, don’t tell me... Did you...?\c\nYep, looks like you went ahead and defeated\nevery student in the Savanna Biome!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_12a

entries.text: Wait, don’t tell me... Did you...?\c\nYep, looks like you went ahead and defeated\nevery student in the Canyon Biome!

entries.text: Wait, don’t tell me... Did you...?\c\nYep, looks like you went ahead and defeated\nevery student in the Coastal Biome!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_12c

entries.text: Wait, don’t tell me... Did you...?\c\nYep, looks like you went ahead and defeated\nevery student in the Polar Biome!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_12d

entries.text: Well, I think you’ve earned yourself a nice\nreward!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_13

entries.text: Oh, and...another extra-special bonus for you!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_14

entries.text: There are guidance counselors like myself in the\nother biomes, y’know! You should go find them!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_15

entries.text: You’ve defeated every student in every biome!\nThat deserves an extra-EXTRA-special bonus!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_16

entries.text: I hope you continue to experience the joy of\nPokémon battling for years to come!
entries.label: s2_sub_040_teacher_17

entries.text: I still can’t believe you defeated every single\nstudent in the Savanna Biome! How impressive!
